maddeler.e: نُمْرُقَة or نِمْرِقَة or نَمْرَقَة • (numruqa or nimriqa or namraqa) f (plural نَمَارِق (namāriq))
maddeler.t: From Parthian nmr (namr, “soft”) + -k (-ak, “adjectival suffix”), "thing having softness"; compare Zazaki nemr (“soft”), Northern Kurdish nerm (“soft”) and Persian نرم (narm, “soft, gentle”).
